Free, open-source clipboard manager for macOS  a native Paste app alternative with color-coded history, pinboards, search & keyboard paste. Signed, notarized, Homebrew.

⌘⌘ - A lightweight, native macOS screenshot tool that lives in your menu bar. Double-tap ⌘ Command to capture any region of your screen — instantly copied to clipboard, or annotate first with pen and mosaic tools.
Buffer is a open-source lightweight, privacy-focused clipboard manager for macOS with searchable history and a quick ⇧⌘V shortcut.
Minimalist macOS OCR tool. Open-source, privacy-first, and built with SwiftUI.
Free open-source bookmark manager with customisable nested tags. Super fast and lightweight. All data is stored locally.
Talk to your Mac — a native macOS voice assistant that sees your screen, drives your Mac, and answers back. Powered by the OpenAI Realtime API. Open source.
A native macOS Markdown editor for academic writing, featuring an integrated Zotero-friendly bibliography manager, spreadsheet databases, and task tracking.
A native macOS app that shows what's draining your battery — live power, per-app energy, charge history, and drain insights. 100% local, no dependencies.
The free, open-source meeting-notes app for your Mac — offline transcription and AI notes, free in the cloud or 100% on-device.
Open-source screenshot and screen recording for macOS. The free, native alternative to CleanShot X. Built with Swift 6.0 and SwiftUI.

repo_meta_data.description: Private, native macOS app to capture pages, text, notes, links, and images—and find them instantly with full-text search and OCR. Open source; no account or telemetry.
